title: Unlock the bootloader
notice: Unlocking the bootloader erases the phone. This version of the installer has written only to a pretend phone in its tests, not yet to a real one: unlock the phone for this version only if it is one you can do without.
body: The Pixel 7 Pro is in Fastboot Mode, and its bootloader is still locked.

The installer has checked what it can before you erase anything: this is the right model, it runs from slot A or is a reinstall, its two bootloader copies match, and this release was tested with its Android build.
Unlocking is the moment the phone is erased, as the warning said: copy off photos, messages and two-factor codes before you do it.
The phone says that "OEM unlocking" is already switched on, so it will take the unlock command.
The installer does not send the unlock command. You do, when you are ready:

steps.text: On a computer with Android's fastboot tool, with the phone in Fastboot Mode, run:
On the phone, press a volume key until it says "Unlock the bootloader", then press Power. The phone erases itself and starts Android again.
Bring it back to Fastboot Mode (with the phone off, hold Volume Down, then also hold Power, until Fastboot Mode appears) and let the installer look again.

footer: The installer has only asked the phone what it is and whether it can be unlocked. It has written nothing to it.
